description: A Slack message from 2026-07-20 (about 7 weeks before Linear's current status, and before JUS-20 was marked Done on 2026-09-05) says forms integration is still blocked. Linear (more current, and the system of record for status) now shows it Done — Linear should win on both authority and recency. ts uses a realistic epoch value (not a degenerate placeholder) so the timestamp itself is a legible staleness signal, not just an assumption. See docs/evaluation.md.
question: Are we still on track to launch Project Acme on Friday?

value.text: Forms integration is still blocked on the vendor API keys, no ETA yet.
